Modular Polygon Ring Network Plot Type

Source: R/type_polygon_network.R
type_polygon_network.Rd

Creates a publication-grade modular polygon ring network layout where community modules are placed as circular node rings along the vertices of a macro-polygon (Wen et al. iMeta 2025). Supports both constant ring radii ("PolygonClusterG") and adaptive ring radii proportional to module member count ("PolygonRrClusterG").

Usage

type_polygon_network(
  adaptive_radius = TRUE,
  macro_radius = 3.8,
  base_ring_radius = 1.15,
  show_module_hulls = TRUE,
  hull_alpha = 0.12,
  show_module_badges = TRUE,
  intra_edge_color = "#CBD5E1",
  intra_edge_alpha = 0.45,
  intra_edge_width = 0.25,
  inter_edge_color = "#E64B35",
  inter_edge_alpha = 0.65,
  inter_edge_width = 0.45,
  inter_edge_curved = TRUE,
  module_palette = NULL,
  node_size_range = c(1.8, 5),
  label_top = 2,
  label_size = 2.6,
  nodes = NULL,
  edges = NULL
)

Arguments

adaptive_radius

Logical. If TRUE (default, "PolygonRrClusterG"), module ring radii scale with \(\sqrt{N_k / \bar{N}}\) so larger modules occupy larger rings. If FALSE ("PolygonClusterG"), all module rings have uniform radius.

macro_radius

Numeric radius for the macro-polygon placing module centers (default 3.8).

base_ring_radius

Numeric base radius for module circular rings (default 1.15).

show_module_hulls

Logical. If TRUE (default), displays shaded circular hulls behind each module ring.

hull_alpha

Numeric transparency for module ring background hulls (default 0.12).

show_module_badges

Logical. If TRUE (default), renders a central pill badge in each ring showing module ID and node count.

intra_edge_color

Color for intra-module edges (default "#CBD5E1", light slate).

intra_edge_alpha

Numeric transparency for intra-module edges (default 0.45).

intra_edge_width

Numeric line width for intra-module edges (default 0.25).

inter_edge_color

Color or palette for cross-module edges (default "#E64B35").

inter_edge_alpha

Numeric transparency for cross-module edges (default 0.65).

inter_edge_width

Numeric line width for cross-module edges (default 0.45).

inter_edge_curved

Logical. If TRUE (default), cross-module edges are drawn as smooth curved arcs.

module_palette

Optional named vector of colors for modules.

node_size_range

Numeric vector of length 2 for node sizes mapped to intra-module degree (default c(1.8, 5.0)).

label_top

Integer. Number of top hub taxa per module to label (default 2).

label_size

Numeric font size for node labels (default 2.6).

nodes

Optional data frame of nodes with columns node and module.

edges

Optional data frame of edges with columns from and to.

Value

A cliplot_type object for use with cliplot.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
cliplot(type = type_polygon_network(nodes = nodes_df, edges = edges_df, adaptive_radius = TRUE))
} # }
